status: Declared on October 7, 2026, after cohort 2 was accepted and before any cohort-3 execution. The project owner chose the upgrade.
capability: Drafting, cohort 1's capability, upgraded: read the latest approved plan revision, or approved revision 1 when the user asks for it or for the change from it, and make calls that do not depend on each other together, two per reply, so a turn fits its budget.

findings.sealed_drafting: On the 192 sealed drafting episodes of the cohort-2 confirmation, the accepted drafting route failed 15, all in the first turn: 9 cited approved revision 1 instead of the latest approved revision, 5 cited the unapproved draft when the user asked for the change from revision 1, and 1 saved the right draft but ran out of model turns before its confirmation.
findings.development_drafting: On the 24 opened development drafting cases, 4 of its 5 failures saved the right draft and then ran out of model turns, having made one call per reply.
findings.cross: Of the 4 sealed cross failures, the handoff's drafting turn cited approved revision 1; the other 3 were review requests on the scheduling route, which this upgrade does not change.

unit.name: L3
unit.module: Rank-16, alpha-32 LoRA on q_proj and v_proj in layers 32..39 (1,048,576 parameters) on top of the frozen accepted update U1: Kaiming-uniform A, zero B, so the untrained module equals U1.
unit.serves: The drafting route only, behind A2's per-episode gate. The scheduling route (U1 with L2), the pinned router and every policy are cohort 2's, unchanged.

experience.source: One verified demonstration per drafting training case, written by the drafting solver as the accepted version's own replies.
experience.verification: Every demonstration must pass the scorer within the drafting policy's limits and read no unapproved revision; one that does not stops the job before training.

training.replay: A2's pinned parent replay items, re-verified from their recorded rollouts.
training.rule: Stage 1's trainer settings for the low-rank module: learning rate 3e-4, microbatch 1, gradient accumulation 8, warmup 8, clip 1.0, weight decay 0.01. Terminal step only; no checkpoint selection.

integration.set: The 64 drafting integration cases, each run alone on the drafting route once greedily and twice sampled at temperature 0.8.

previous.system: Cohort 2's accepted system: the pinned router, U1 behind A2's per-episode gate on the drafting route, and U1 with L2 on the scheduling route under the free-slot policy.

development_gate.sets: The opened development cases: 24 drafting, 24 scheduling and 8 cross. The upgraded system runs on one CPU host on the canonical runtime with prefix-cache serving; the previous system's development episodes are pinned, and both are rescored.
development_gate.lost: The upgraded system loses none of the previous system's successes on any of the three sets.
development_gate.latency: Episode wall time plus every per-turn selection forward pass and A2's per-episode pass.

confirmation_gate.opens: Once, only after the upgraded system passes development.
confirmation_gate.systems: The upgraded and the previous system, each on drafting and, on a second host, on scheduling and cross: four CPU hosts.
confirmation_gate.lost: The upgraded system loses none of the previous system's successes on drafting, scheduling or cross.

resource_budget.training: One A10G host within the $10 GPU allowance.
resource_budget.rule: A3 asks for an update that proves better than keeping the previous system under a declared resource budget. The upgrade adds exactly one rank-16 module, trains on one GPU host within its allowance, and its p95 on the sealed episodes may be at most 10% above the previous system's on the same episodes, as well as within 180 s. Passing the confirmation gate within this budget is that comparison.

sealed.rule: Fresh splits, frozen in this declaration before any cohort-3 training. They open once, only after the upgraded system passes development.

acceptance: Passing the confirmation accepts cohort 3. With cohorts 1 and 2, that is A3's three successive accepted cohorts with cumulative retention, a new capability and an upgrade. Acceptance is not native promotion.

budget.allowances: Stage 1 through cohort 2's confirmation cost $91.18. Cohort 3: GPU at most $10 on one A10G host with a five-hour expiry, development at most $6 on one CPU host, confirmation at most $37.60 on four CPU hosts; $144.78 within the $150 ceiling.
